title: Check It!
description: This Mod adds a satisfactory styled task list that shows the items/blocks you need to make something (intended for the create mod)
body:
**Check It!** is a lightweight, intuitive todo list designed for builders and survivalists.

**Features**:
• Persistent Todo Lists: Manage your crafting goals and build steps in-game.
• **Progress Tracking**: Watch your list update automatically as you gather materials.
• **Minimalist HUD**: Keep your focus on the game with a clean, unobtrusive overlay.

Built for those who value efficiency, Check Off helps you keep your inventory 
and your project plans in perfect sync. No more alt-tabbing to notepad—stay in the game.
